sections.body: Three are fruits. The car is different. The car is the ODD ONE OUT! 🚗
Put your toys in groups: things that are red, things that are soft, things with wheels.
Ask 'why?' after each answer. There can be more than one good answer, and explaining is the real skill.

quiz.q: Which is the odd one out? 🐶 🐱 ✏️
hints: Look: ☀️ ⭐ 🍌. Two are in the sky, so the banana is different.
quiz.explain: The pencil is not an animal! ✏️

quiz.q: Which is the odd one out? 🔴 🔴 🔵
hints: Look: 🟢 🟡 🟢. The yellow one is different.
quiz.explain: The blue circle is a different colour! 🔵
